title_en: VEIL — MAGELLAN'S RADAR MAP OF VENUS
description: An interactive field guide to NASA's Magellan: how a 3.7 m dish and synthetic-aperture radar at 12.6 cm saw through Venus's clouds at 120–300 m resolution, how 243-day cycles mapped 98% of the planet strip by strip, what roughly 940 scattered craters say about a surface only about half a billion years old, and how Magellan became the first spacecraft to aerobrake into a new orbit at another planet.
og: 12.6 cm radar, 120–300 m pixels, 98% of Venus in 25 km strips, and the first planetary aerobraking: Magellan, interactive and sourced from JPL's own guides.
brand: VEIL — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
